$comment: How often a route or stop is served, as the site shows it (frequency chips on stop and station cards, the route card's day strip; apps/web/README.md#service-frequency). Average minutes between departures in an hour, banded; a band covers up to and including maxMinutes, and the last band has none. These are a presentation choice made on the UI concepts canvas (2026-10-12), not a TransLink standard. Colours are per theme in apps/web/src/index.css (--band-*).
